user.title: Set up a panel
user.description: Install ha-paneld on a new panel, check an existing installation, or connect a panel that is already running ha-paneld.

menu_option_descriptions.install_or_upgrade: Check that a panel is safe and ready for a first installation.
menu_option_descriptions.connect_existing: Attach a healthy ha-paneld installation to Home Assistant.

install_or_upgrade.title: Install ha-paneld on a panel
install_or_upgrade.description: Enter the hostname or IP address of the Android panel. Home Assistant will first check for ha-paneld, then perform a read-only Android Debug Bridge (ADB) readiness check. No software is installed during this prototype check. Later updates are managed after the panel is connected.

connect_existing.title: Connect an existing panel
connect_existing.description: Enter the hostname or IP address of a panel already running ha-paneld.

confirm_existing.title: ha-paneld is already installed
confirm_existing.description: A healthy ha-paneld installation was found at {address}. Submit to connect it to Home Assistant for monitoring and future updates. No installation will be performed.

confirm_clean_install.title: First-install candidate found
confirm_clean_install.description: The Android panel at {address} is reachable and the ha-paneld package is proven absent. Device: model {model}; serial {serial}; ABI {abi}; Android SDK {sdk}. Stable release preview: version {version}; tag {tag}; SHA-256 {sha256}. This prototype only previews the candidate: it will not download or install anything, and submitting it makes no changes.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to a valid ha-paneld health endpoint.
error.invalid_address: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL scheme or path.
error.adb_unreachable: ha-paneld did not respond and Android Debug Bridge (ADB) could not be reached. Check that the address is correct, the panel is online, and network debugging is enabled, then try again.
error.adb_unauthorized: The panel is reachable through Android Debug Bridge (ADB), but Home Assistant is not authorized. Approve the debugging prompt on the panel, then try again.
error.installed_without_health: The ha-paneld package is installed but its health endpoint did not respond. This flow will not overwrite or repair an unverified installation. Restore the existing installation or use a dedicated recovery workflow, then try again.
error.retained_or_ambiguous: The panel may contain retained ha-paneld data or its package state could not be proven clean. This flow refuses a clean install to protect existing data. Inspect or recover the existing installation before trying again.
error.incompatible: The panel is proven clean, but its Android SDK or processor architecture is not supported by ha-paneld. Nothing was downloaded or installed.
error.cannot_resolve_release: The panel is ready, but Home Assistant could not resolve and verify the current stable ha-paneld release. No software was downloaded or installed. Check internet access and try again.

abort.prototype_ready: The first-install candidate and exact stable release were previewed. Nothing was downloaded, installed, or changed.
abort.unknown: The setup flow lost its pending panel state. Start setup again.
